requirements.GLA02: Attribute first race, restart, re-entry and retry loading
requirements.GLA03: Use offline private profiles; retain commands, results and limitations

scenario: Stock Compact/Rally, Pine Star spline, 1280x720; Dummy audio and music off; optional Garage warming suppressed
conclusions: Cold road preparation and ground/checkpoint work dominate this Star example, together about 7.96 seconds of 14.92. These are wall intervals, not isolated CPU measurements.
Race feature and Game resource graphs load on first entry in each process, about 3.5-3.9 seconds across accepted observations.

Final covered graphics/effects stages account for about 1.1 seconds in the fresh detailed trace. Renderer frame intervals during worker waits overlap CPU work and must not be added to it or called shader compilation time.
Prepared car configuration is tens of milliseconds in first entry and around 10 milliseconds on re-entry.
Fresh-process reuse involves road/checkpoint/scenery and renderer caches together; the fresh/restart delta is not attributable solely to scenery caching.
Source-checkout scenery identity checks cost about 0.4-0.6 seconds; these are included in total entry time. Packaged identity behavior differs.
Startup confirmation: engine timestamp to first guest menu 4.267 seconds, App resource load 1.824 seconds, App initialization 0.185 seconds. No optional feature resources or header captures.
limits: Desktop observations, not statistical benchmarking, Android qualification or a universal load-time bound. OS/driver caches and other owner work were not controlled.
Race timers begin with an already compiled selected track and exclude backend requests, menu navigation and the following three-second countdown.
Startup engine timestamps exclude OS process launch; backend bootstrap/session restoration is disabled.
Initial startup observation overlapped news/menu/build identity edits and is excluded from the primary startup figure; confirmation is source-stable.
world-trace overlaps only a generated build identity update and fails optional cache publication; it is diagnostic. world-confirm repeats attribution with unchanged production sources.
No device query/test, export, backend request, owner-save change or owner-process restart.
